# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 95 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 95

**1** Jesus said: "If you have money, don't loan it out for profit. Give it instead to someone you know will never pay you back."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "For profit" — usury rendered as profit-seeking
- "Know will never pay you back" — the hopelessness of repayment made more certain
- The radical giving ethic is made more concrete
